devices.name: Microwave I
devices.notes: OS 2.00. Single/Poly ignores Part; Multi selects Part 1-8. Requires additive checksum. Native BCL checksum execution is unqualified: file-only in this editor.

documentation.section: SysEx 2.00 rev00 (1994-03-01): RTBP 60h, BPRD table, BYTE encoding and CHKSUM

devices.name: Microwave II / XT / XTk
devices.notes: Match Device ID. Single mode: Part 1 (location 00); Multi: the selected part sound edit buffer. SNDP omits the checksum.

documentation.section: SysEx: 2.13 SNDP (20h); 3.1 Sound parameter table

devices.name: Blofeld
devices.notes: Match Device ID. Single mode: Part 1 (location 00); Multi: the selected part sound edit buffer. SNDP omits the checksum.

documentation.section: SysEx: 2.13 SNDP (20h); 3.1 Sound parameter table

devices.name: TX81Z
devices.notes: Enable exclusive reception; match Basic Receive Channel. VCED group 12h edits the current voice, without STORE.

documentation.section: Owner Manual printed pp.67,71 / PDF pp.68,72: Parameter Change / VCED

devices.name: DX7
devices.notes: Voice edit buffer. Enable System Info/Exclusive and match receive channel (DX7) or Device number (DX7II/DX7s). Check hardware memory-protect if edits are ignored. No persistent STORE included.

documentation.section: MIDI Data Format: Parameter Change / voice table; PDF pp.31-33

devices.name: DX7II FD / D
devices.notes: Voice edit buffer. Enable System Info/Exclusive and match receive channel (DX7) or Device number (DX7II/DX7s). Check hardware memory-protect if edits are ignored. No persistent STORE included.

documentation.section: MIDI Data Format Add-2, Add-8; PDF pp.96,102

devices.name: DX7s
devices.notes: Voice edit buffer. Enable System Info/Exclusive and match receive channel (DX7) or Device number (DX7II/DX7s). Check hardware memory-protect if edits are ignored. No persistent STORE included.

documentation.section: MIDI Data Format Parameter Change / 5-1 Voice Parameter, Add-9; PDF p.98

devices.name: DX21
devices.notes: Enable MIDI SYS INFO, match receive channel and use EDIT mode for voice parameter edits. No STORE.

documentation.section: MIDI Data Format: Parameter Change and Voice Parameters (VCED); printed pp.48,51,54 / PDF pp.49,52,55

devices.name: AN1x
devices.notes: Native model 5Ch; explicitly select Scene 1 or 2. Match Device number, enable exclusive reception. Resonance starts at 0Dh; 19h is zero offset.

documentation.section: Data List pp.13-15: 3-5-3-2 / Current Voice Scene Buffer table

devices.name: AN200
devices.notes: Native model 5Ch, Current Voice Element address 10 10. These are element parameters, distinct from Scene macro offsets 0F/10. Match Device number and enable SysEx reception.

documentation.section: Owner Manual pp.119-123: 2.1.3 Native parameter change / table 1-1 and Current Voice Element Buffer

devices.name: FS1R
devices.notes: Native model 5Eh. Part selects Voice Common 40h-43h. All parameter changes carry two value bytes (MS7 then LS7), even for 7-bit values. Enable Receive System Exclusive.

documentation.section: Data List pp.37,39: 3.1 Parameter Change / Voice Common Parameter

devices.name: CS1x
devices.notes: XG model 4Ch, Multi mode Part 1-16. Filter values are offsets: 00=-64, 40=0, 7F=+63. Drum voices ignore these tone edits. Not a native Performance Layer template.

documentation.section: Data List pp.21,23: 3-6-3-3 XG Parameter Change / MULTI PART table

devices.name: CS2x
devices.notes: XG model 4Ch, Multi mode Part 1-16. Filter values are offsets: 00=-64, 40=0, 7F=+63. Drum voices ignore these tone edits. Not a native Performance Layer template.

documentation.section: Data List pp.30-31: 3-6-3-3 XG Parameter Change / MULTI PART table

devices.name: JX-8P
devices.notes: IPR operation 36h, format 21h, Level/Group 01/01. Enable Exclusive and match basic MIDI channel. Original JX-8P protocol; not JX-10 or aftermarket firmware.

documentation.section: MIDI Implementation 3.2 Individual Tone Parameter (IPR), entries 34,35

devices.name: Alpha Juno-2
devices.notes: JU-2 format 23h, Level 20h, Group 01h. Enable EXCL and match basic MIDI channel. No DT1 checksum or memory write.

documentation.section: MIDI Implementation v1.1 (1986-01-27), 3.2 IPR; PDF p.48

devices.name: Juno-106
devices.notes: Set rear MIDI FUNCTION switch to III; match MIDI channel. Individual parameter function 32h, distinct from Alpha Juno IPR.

documentation.section: MIDI Implementation 2.3, 3.3, 3.4; PDF p.35

devices.name: DW-8000
devices.notes: Set MIDI Enable (85) to 2; match MIDI Channel (84). Use value-modified offsets 15/16, not packed dump offsets. Cutoff 0-63, resonance 0-31.

documentation.section: MIDI Implementation Parameter Change, PDF p.65; value-modified bitmap PDF p.68

devices.name: DW-6000
devices.notes: Model 04h with fixed format ID 30h, distinct from the DW-8000 channel-coded format. Enable exclusive reception. Cutoff offset 5 and resonance offset 6 are unshared byte fields.

documentation.section: Owner Manual MIDI Implementation Parameter Change, PDF p.48; bitmap printed p.48 / PDF p.50

devices.name: M1
devices.notes: Enable exclusive reception. Fixed requests ask the M1 to send its edit buffer. Replies are not automatically decoded here; this is not instantaneous controller-value readout. Prefer a push/button.

documentation.section: MIDI Exclusive Format, PDF p.125: Program Parameter Dump Request 10h / Combination Parameter Dump Request 19h

devices.name: Bass Station II
devices.notes: Requires firmware with AFX support. Select the overlay bank on hardware first. Value selects overlay index 0-24; its 106-byte reply is not decoded here. Read request only, no clear/save/import.

documentation.section: Official appendix: AFX mode SysEx support / Export
